AIRLIFT & LOGISTICS

Military transport.

Aircraft that carry personnel, equipment, and supplies, including support for disaster relief and medical transport.

Category
Military aircraft

OverviewCommon rolesQuestionsReal-world example
01 / THE AIRCRAFT’S ROLE

Designed around its mission.

Transport aircraft prioritize useful cargo volume and load handling. Airlift connects bases and destinations; some designs are adapted for shorter or less-developed airfields. Capability depends on the model.

RECOGNIZABLE FEATURES

Large cargo access, a roomy fuselage, and on many designs a high wing and rear loading ramp.

02 / COMMON ROLES

Where it fits.

  • Personnel and equipment transport
  • Humanitarian relief
  • Medical evacuation

Military aircraft categories can overlap. Equipment and capabilities vary by model, variant, and operator.

03 / A CLOSER LOOK

Good question.

Are military transports only used for military cargo?

No. They can also support humanitarian relief, medical missions, and emergency resupply.
